In other words, for the&nbsp; pairs of \x3Cspan>x\x3C/span> and \x3Cspan>y\x3C/span> in the given table, \x3Cspan>m\x3C/span> = 2.&nbsp;The value of \x3Cspan>b\x3C/span> can be found by substituting the values of \x3Cspan>x\x3C/span> and \x3Cspan>y\x3C/span> from any row of the table and substituting the value of \x3Cspan>m\x3C/span> into the equation \x3Cspan>y\x3C/span> = \x3Cspan>mx\x3C/span> + \x3Cspan>b\x3C/span> and then solving for \x3Cspan>b\x3C/span>.
